description: Find stock and other asset trades reported by members of the US Congress (House and Senate Periodic Transaction Reports under the STOCK Act; branch=congress, the default) or by the US President (OGE Form 278-T, as read from the scanned filings by Open Cabinet, a third party; branch=executive). Filter by a person's name, chamber, ticker, purchase or sale, and a period. Amounts are bands as filed (amount_band, with its bounds in USD), never exact amounts. Congress rows carry the days from trade to filing and whether the filing came after the legal deadline, with the fact. The filings give no price; where the share has a price series the row carries the change in the share price since the filing (and for the executive since the trade). Every row carries source_url, the filing; executive rows also credit Open Cabinet. Default period: the last 365 days.

branch.description: congress = members of the House and Senate (default); executive = the President (OGE, read by Open Cabinet).

days.description: Look back this many days from today. Default 365. Leave out when you give from.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 20.

name.description: Part of the person's name, e.g. Pelosi or Trump.

ticker.description: The ticker of the traded security, e.g. NVDA.

type.description: buy = purchases, sell = sales (including partial sales), all = also exchanges. Default all.

name: search_politician_trades
title: Search trades by members of Congress and the US executive (STOCK Act, OGE)
